summary: Brain-side data are abundant but narrow: Allen (mouse, human, NHP), 404 endocast media on MorphoSource and brainmuseum.org section images give material to measure folding, and Zenodo holds human cortical surface/thickness tables (10.5281/zenodo.61348, CC BY 4.0), but no cross-species table of cortical surface area vs brain or body mass was found in any repository. For gut mucosal surface area and the shark spiral valve, every search returned zero datasets.
next_step: Compile the comparative cortical surface/thickness/volume table from the literature (Mota & Herculano-Houzel 2015 supplement and sources cited there) and a vertebrate intestinal surface-area compilation (Chivers & Hladik-type data) with body masses, deposit them, then pre-register a surface-to-mass scaling test per organ.
obstacles_confirmed: Surface area is rarely annotated directly: repositories hold images and scans, not surface measurements.
Brain-image archives are dominated by a few model species rather than a body-size series: Allen is mouse/human/NHP only.
Gut and brain surface areas are scattered by species and by measurement method: no gut surface dataset was found at all.
